criteria.criterion: Retrieve the recall object from the specified CPSC endpoint (RecallID=10000)
criteria.description: Use only the recall object returned by https://www.saferproducts.gov/RestWebServices/Recall?RecallID=10000&format=json (or the equivalent supplied endpoint for RecallID=10000). Full credit if the agent clearly bases the response on that returned object OR clearly reports that the endpoint could not be accessed/returned no data (e.g., network error, non-JSON/empty response) without fabricating fields. Partial credit if the agent’s sourcing is unclear but content appears consistent with the endpoint. No credit if the agent primarily uses other sources/other recall IDs or fabricates content.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshots 1-3 each show a CPSC recall API-style JSON array with a single object containing "RecallID":10000 (latest: Screenshot 3 still shows RecallID 10000). Action history shows visiting the saferproducts.gov Recall endpoint with RecallID=10000&format=json&display=all.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports that the agent retrieved/used the correct recall object for RecallID=10000 from the specified endpoint context. No blocker or wrong recall ID is indicated.

Full credit if all four are present and exact OR if the agent explicitly states which of these fields are missing/not present in the returned object (or that the object could not be retrieved) and does not invent values. Partial credit if one field is missing or has minor transcription errors when the fields are present. No credit if multiple are incorrect/fabricated.

Partial credit if some but not all products are included (when multiple exist) or one of the two fields per product is missing. No credit if products are substituted from Description/other fields or fabricated.
